description: How the Studio converts a major-1 drama into major 2 (doc/protocol.md, section 8). Normative data: the client applies it as written and knows no major-1 record format beyond it. Every path is project-relative; {object} is a v1 object id with its version segment removed, {owner} the object a record stage belongs to, {file} a path inside a version folder.

version_folders.a_version_folder_is: a folder holding version.json whose name matches one of version_folder_name_patterns
version_folders.applied_in_order: one global order across all objects: by version.json made_at, then object id, then version id; one commit per version, authored studio-found-changes-on-disk. So history reads as it happened, and every input a receipt names is already at its major-2 path.

writes.{owner}/entry.json: entry.json without entry_json_drop_fields and without the description field (description_field_by_owner_kind); every other field (look, members, establishing, …) stays

writes.{owner}/description.md.receipt.json: the receipt rule below, from this describe version's job.json, only when {owner}'s current entry version was written from this call: its artifact.json metadata has source.kind "describe" and source.call naming this describe version. A description the person wrote later (entry describe) has no receipt.

every_other_version.copies: each file artifact.json lists under outputs, at {object}/{file}, except what skip_folders_in_version and skip_files_in_version name; input/ is copied, which keeps bible/input/brief.md and bible/input/screenplay.md
every_other_version.a_file_dropped_by_a_later_version: is deleted in that version's commit, with its receipt, when the later version no longer lists it
every_other_version.also_copies_note: a key matches a v1 object id, * standing for one path segment; technical-check.json is written after artifact.json, so artifact.json does not list it

receipt_rule.beside: each file the version copies (outputs), as <file>.receipt.json, in the same commit

fields.inputs_sent_in_order: version.json inputs in order, each {path: the input version's shown file at its major-2 path, sha256: that file's hash}; an input whose version has no shown file is left out
fields.cost: {usd: job.json actual_usd, reported_by: "pine" when job.json connection is set, otherwise job.json provider}; null when actual_usd is null

not_version_folders.config/<v>/drama-cli.cfg.yaml: the newest is written to drama-cli.cfg.yaml at the root
not_version_folders.turns/: dropped (in history); read first for the snapshots above
not_version_folders.choices.json: dropped (in history); read first for current, discarded and the person's pending text

current.rule: after every version's commit, a last commit sets each kept object's files to the files of its major-1 current version (major 1's 3.2: the chosen version, else the newest not discarded) and writes every object.json (see object_json)
current.removed_objects: an object choices.json marks removed is deleted, with every variant under it
current.pending_text: choices.json prompt and description fields become {object}/prompt.md and {object}/description.md

read_from: when the folder has no turns/: the Studio's own records of that drama (returns/<task>.json in its storage), the same installed snapshots
snapshots.when_neither_exists: the conversion refuses, changes nothing, and asks the person to open the project once in the previous Studio (major 1), which writes turns/, with a link to its download
snapshots.an_object_is_kept_when: the latest installed snapshot of its scope lists it (the Project Chat's for shared objects and episode objects, a snapshot listing its episode for an episode's objects), as major 1's 5.3 has it; an object it no longer lists is deleted in the last commit

object_json.written_for: every object the kept snapshots list, and every asset or variant with an entry stage; no other folder gets one (looks/face, plan)

one_source_per_field.type, name, setting, variant_of, relatio: from the object's current entry version when it has an entry stage (record_stages /entry), otherwise from the latest snapshot that lists it (type, name, segment; relations from its edges inside_of, appears_in, needs; variant_of from its edge variant_of)
one_source_per_field.shown_file: always the current version's version.json file

object_json.written_in: the last commit (current), once, so no commit order decides a field
